featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable 24-Day Safari & Culture Journey Through India – With Raj and Wanderlust Travel Hub

From the moment we first connected with Raj from Wanderlust Travel Hub, we knew we were in the best hands. A dear mutual friend referred us to him, and after more than a year of thoughtful planning and communication, our dream of exploring India came to life in the most personal, heartfelt, and beautifully organized way imaginable.

This was our very first visit to India — a place we had always dreamed of — and what Raj created for us will stay in our hearts forever. From the start on November 7th in Delhi, we began our journey to Jim Corbett National Park, where luck was on our side — a magnificent tiger appeared beside the road just minutes before reaching our lodge! Over the next 24 days, we traveled through some of India’s most iconic national parks and cultural treasures, each day full of wonder:

- Jim Corbett and the rare Great Hornbill sightings
- The Taj Mahal and city of Agra with our a knowledgeable local guide
- Keoladeo National Park with its spectacular birdlife
- Ranthambore with its stunning fort and amazing wildlife
- Chambal Gharial Sanctuary — spotting the critically endangered gharial crocodiles
- Jaipur’s charm, history, shopping and great local streetfood
- Visits to Tadoba, Pench, Kanha, and Bandhavgarh — we had 20 safaris in total on our tour, spotting tigers, wild dogs, sloth bears, countless birds, and the endless beauty of India’s wilderness
- Our final days brought us to Khajuraho’s mesmerizing temples and the tastiest aloo chaat street food we’ve ever had! A spontaneous stop Gwalior to see the awe-inspiring Gopachal Jain Statues and Gwalior Fort was the perfect way to close this magical journey before returning to Delhi.

None of this would have been the same without Raj. Beyond being a phenomenal tour organizer, he became a true friend — someone whose warmth, humor, and genuine care turned every day into a joy. His daily surprises with local food, his stories, and his kind guidance made us experience India not as visitors but as family.

A special mention also goes to our wonderful driver, Shubhram, whose calmness, skill, and friendly presence made long journeys smooth and safe.

If you are planning to visit India — especially for your first time — we cannot recommend Wanderlust Travel Hub highly enough. Raj creates journeys that are not just well-organized and safe, but deeply personal. Every lodge, guide, and experience feels handpicked with love and authenticity.

We will carry India — and Raj — in our hearts forever.

featured_reviews.name: Chelsya Wemyss
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had quite a rollercoaster experience with Tripventure while planning our honeymoon.

We first got in touch with the team in December to plan our February honeymoon and initially spoke with Darshita. She and the team advised us not to visit Greece in February as it isn’t considered the ideal season. While that advice was valid, my husband and I were very keen on going there for our honeymoon.

Since Greece was the main destination we wanted to visit and obtaining a Greek visa isn’t always the easiest process we explored several permutations and combinations of destinations that could work alongside Greece. Our initial plan was to travel to Turkey and Greece. That later changed to Istanbul and Greece based on suggestions from the team. Eventually, we finalized our itinerary as France and Greece.

Despite contacting them in December, we did not receive an estimated cost for the entire trip until January. During that time, I constantly had to follow up with Darshita every few days instead of receiving proactive updates from their side. Unfortunately, the visa process was also quite stressful. We had to repeatedly call Darshita and Swapnil (who was handling visas) just to understand which documents were required, what payments needed to be made, and how to secure our visa appointment.

My husband and I were also planning our wedding in the middle of all this,  which was in the first week of February. Constantly following up with the team during such a hectic time was not easy for us.

We received our visas on the 5th of February, but even by the 9th there was still no acknowledgment or finalization of our itinerary and flights, even though we were planning to travel on the 13th. After pushing for an update, Darshita sent us an itinerary that was identical to the one we had first received in January, without any of the changes we had discussed afterward.

By the 11th of February, we were still trying to finalize hotels when Darshita and Urvi informed us that they would be traveling and that our case would be handed over to someone else. At that point, we genuinely felt like our honeymoon might not even happen.

That’s when Mitali stepped in.

When we first spoke to Mitali, she had no context about our plans, what we wanted, our travel dates, or what had already been booked and not booked. The handover clearly hadn’t been done properly. However, once we explained everything and shared the itinerary we had finalized, she completely took charge.

Because of the earlier delays, we couldn’t fly out on the 13th as originally planned and instead left on the 15th. Which was sad, becuse we wanted Valentines day in France. Despite the extremely short timeline, Mitali managed to secure our flights, hotels, and arrangements exactly the way we wanted. Even while we were traveling through France and Greece, she was always just a message away whenever we needed help.

Mitali truly was a lifesaver, and we are very grateful to her for making our honeymoon possible.

Unfortunately, because of all the last-minute bookings caused by earlier delays, we ended up paying more than double what we had initially been quoted.

I would definitely suggest going to Mitali to plan your next trip. She really did an amazing job with our honeymoon with whatever little time she had.

Thank you so much Mitali for making our Honeymoon possible and so amazing.
